class.name: FlyingMode
class.brief_description: Moving freely in three dimensions, with no gravity and no floor.
class.description: Unlike [WalkingMode], the input is not flattened against anything: whatever direction the pawn asked for is the direction it accelerates in, capped by [member CharacterMovementComponent.max_fly_speed]. Nothing here decides when to stop flying. A flying character that finds ground under it has not landed - something else has to say so, which is what a [MovementModeTransition] is for.
